description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) HEADHUNTER DOCTRINE (Ironstorm Spearhead, 1 CP) — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Marine player gets the seven WP-M3a detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. SELECT_SHOOTER of the Gladiator Lancer (VEHICLE, not DEDICATED TRANSPORT/FLY/WALKER) opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a REAL click spends 1 CP; its ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS] against MONSTER/VEHICLE targets — then it shoots the Mek Gunz (VEHICLE).
